macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Fed minutes signal another rate hike may be needed
items.summary: Minutes from the Federal Reserve’s September meeting showed that most officials considered another interest-rate increase likely necessary this year to combat persistent inflation. The Fed had raised its policy rate by a quarter point to approximately 3.9% at that meeting.[1][9]

items.title: U.S. stocks retreat from records as Treasury yields rise
items.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell 0.2% while the Dow declined 0.7% as rising Treasury yields pressured equities. The 10-year yield briefly reached about 5.36%, its highest level since 2002, while the 30-year yield climbed above 5.7%.[1][9]

items.title: Oil rises above $100 amid Middle East supply concerns
items.summary: Brent crude moved back above $100 a barrel as uncertainty surrounding the conflict in the Middle East raised concerns about when energy production and supply chains could normalize.[2][3]

items.title: Global markets weaken after Wall Street decline
items.summary: Asian shares traded lower after the U.S. market retreat, with South Korea’s Kospi falling about 2% amid a sharp decline in SK Hynix. U.S. equity futures were mixed.[1][3]

items.title: Third-quarter earnings season approaches with strong growth expectations
items.summary: Analysts expect aggregate S&P 500 earnings growth of roughly 30.6% for the third quarter, led by projected gains of 114.7% in energy and 66.5% in technology.[2]

items.title: Worthington Steel drops after weaker quarterly results
items.summary: Worthington Steel shares fell 10.5% after the metals processor reported quarterly results below analyst expectations.[3]

items.title: Constellation Brands rises on stronger profit
items.summary: Constellation Brands gained 0.8% after reporting quarterly profit that exceeded analyst expectations, supported by its beer portfolio including Modelo.[3]

items.title: Wolfspeed shares jump on conditional $1.5 billion loan commitment
items.summary: Wolfspeed stock surged more than 18% in overnight trading after a U.S. government office announced a conditional $1.5 billion loan commitment for the semiconductor company.[5]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin slips below $83,000 as geopolitical tensions weigh on crypto
items.summary: Bitcoin fell about 1.2% over 24 hours to roughly $82,700 after reports that the White House requested military strike options against Iran. The broader crypto market declined about 1.25% to $2.8 trillion, with more than $400 million in liquidations; XRP, Solana and Dogecoin also fell.[4]

items.title: Spot crypto ETFs see heavy outflows
items.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded approximately $487 million in net outflows, while spot Ethereum ETFs saw about $160 million leave on Wednesday, adding pressure to major crypto assets.[4]

items.title: U.S. SEC advances crypto custody framework
items.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission is reportedly moving closer to proposing new cryptocurrency custody rules as it develops a broader digital-asset regulatory framework amid uncertainty over congressional legislation.[1]

items.title: CFTC develops separate crypto regulatory framework
items.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission is advancing its own cryptocurrency market framework after the U.S. Senate failed to move forward with the CLARITY Act.[6]

items.title: Abstract announces phased shutdown of Ethereum Layer 2
items.summary: Ethereum Layer 2 network Abstract said it will gradually cease operations after nearly three years and formally close on December 15, 2026, requiring users to migrate their assets.[5]

items.title: Coinbase completes Deribit integration and plans Coinbase Pro relaunch
items.summary: Coinbase has completed its integration of crypto-options exchange Deribit and plans to relaunch the Coinbase Pro trading platform before the end of 2026.[5]

items.title: Dominion shuts down after security breach and liquidity collapse
items.summary: Solana-based silver-tokenization project Dominion announced its closure after a September security breach caused a mass sell-off of SILV tokens, liquidity loss and a breakdown in its market structure.[5]

items.title: Russia registers first crypto exchanges and custodians
items.summary: The Bank of Russia announced its first approved cryptocurrency exchange operators and digital-asset custodians under newly effective regulations. Sberbank plans to launch crypto products supporting Bitcoin, Ether and USDT on December 1.[10]

items.title: Cardano rises on AI-agent payments integration
items.summary: Cardano’s ADA gained roughly 4% over 24 hours and reached a four-month high after the blockchain integrated with the x402 payment standard for AI agents.[1]

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Rein Security raises $25 million for AI-agent runtime security
items.summary: Rein Security announced a $25 million Series A led by Glilot Capital and Sienna Venture Capital, bringing its total funding to $35 million. The company develops runtime security tools for enterprise AI agents.

items.title: Singapore regulator issues first AI-risk guidelines for financial institutions
items.summary: Singapore’s Monetary Authority issued its first AI-risk guidelines for financial institutions. The guidelines are scheduled to take effect in October 2027.

items.title: Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 5.5
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5, describing it as the fastest and most efficient model in the Claude 5.5 family. The model is available through AWS Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS at substantially lower pricing than Haiku 4.5.

items.title: Cloudflare releases open-weight Clef decision models
items.summary: Cloudflare introduced Clef, open-weight 9B and 27B multimodal decision models that return probabilities for predefined options rather than generating free-form text. Cloudflare also announced a fine-tuning service for the models.

items.title: Mistral previews 1-trillion-parameter Large 4 model
items.summary: Mistral released a public preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 49 billion active parameters. The open-weight model is positioned for enterprise and government applications where data control and sovereignty matter.

items.title: Liquid AI reports faster speculative decoding for vision-language model
items.summary: Liquid AI released an experimental drafter model for LFM2.5-VL-3B that uses speculative decoding without changing output quality. The company reports speedups of up to 3.13 times on-device and 2.66 times on an H100 GPU.

items.title: Argonne demonstrates agentic AI microscope
items.summary: Argonne National Laboratory reported a successful run of an agentic AI microscope at its 26-ID hard X-ray nanoprobe beamline. The system was directed using natural-language instructions.

items.title: GitHub announces model for detecting leaked secrets
items.summary: GitHub announced a fine-tuned model designed to identify leaked secrets, including passwords that do not use recognizable token formats. The development targets a significant gap in conventional secret-scanning tools.

items.title: Google demonstrates Gemini 3.8 Live for golf coaching
items.summary: Google published a demonstration of Gemini 3.8 Live analyzing high-speed motion-capture data and turning it into conversational golf-swing coaching. The example highlights multimodal, real-time reasoning applications.

items.title: ONLYOFFICE adds context-aware AI tools
items.summary: ONLYOFFICE released version 10.0 of its open-source office suite, adding context-aware AI tools and fixing 35 vulnerabilities. The release combines productivity features with a substantial security update.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Gears of War: E-Day launches on Xbox, PC, and Game Pass
items.summary: Microsoft and The Coalition released Gears of War: E-Day for Xbox Series X|S and PC, with availability through Xbox Game Pass Ultimate. The release was accompanied by a launch trailer.

items.title: Resident Evil Requiem releases across major platforms
items.summary: Capcom released Resident Evil Requiem on PC, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 2, alongside a launch trailer.

items.title: Valve grants BC.Game an exception for PGL Major Singapore qualification
items.summary: Valve ruled that BC.Game Esports may pursue qualification for the PGL Major Singapore 2026 through the Asian region after a dispute involving revised Valve Regional Standings rules. The decision does not itself confirm a Major invitation.

items.title: Unity and Google announce an AI-focused gaming partnership
items.summary: Unity and Google announced plans for an integrated gaming platform combining Google’s AI capabilities with Unity development tools. The initiative is intended to help creators build games through natural-language and AI-assisted workflows.

items.title: Google introduces experimental AI game-creation platform
items.summary: Google presented Playground, an experimental browser-based platform designed to let users create simple games with generative AI.

items.title: Amazon ends publishing agreement with Maverick Games
items.summary: Amazon Games reportedly ended its publishing deal with Maverick Games, a studio founded by former Playground Games developers. Maverick is developing a high-budget, story-driven open-world racing game and is seeking a new publishing partner.

items.title: Game Changers Americas LCQ schedule announced
items.summary: Riot Games released the format and schedule for the 2026 Game Changers Americas Last Chance Qualifier, which will determine the region’s second qualifier for the São Paulo championship.

items.title: Neverness to Everness gets global launch date
items.summary: Perfect World Games and Hotta Studio announced that the free-to-play open-world action RPG Neverness to Everness will launch globally on April 29, 2026, for PlayStation 5, PC, iOS, and Android.

items.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer releases
items.summary: Fuse Games released the roguelite racing game Star Wars: Galactic Racer on PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5.

items.title: Behaviour Interactive releases NieR: Automata cosmetics for Dead by Daylight
items.summary: Dead by Daylight received a paid cosmetic collection based on NieR: Automata.
